sloka: स नीलमिव जीमूतं तोयपूर्णं नभस्थलात् ।आपपात गृहीत्वा तु हनुमान् शिखरं गिरेः ।। ६.१०२.३० ।।
transliteration: sa nīlamiva jīmūtaṁ toyapūrṇaṁ nabhasthalāt ।āpapāta gṛhītvā tu hanumān śikharaṁ gireḥ ।। 6.102.30 ।।

translations.english: Highly brilliant Hanuman used his intellect and thought to seize the peak of the mountain on which herbs had sprung.
